tagline.en_US: Manage database changes, access and workflows through a browser-based workspace. The image contains its own database, so this profile does not require a second service.

description.en_US: Bytebase is an open-source database governance platform that serves as a central control plane between users and databases. It unifies change management, access control, and compliance into a single web workspace. Teams use it to review and automate schema migrations, enforce SQL standards, manage role-based database permissions, and maintain complete audit trails of database operations.
